allowed.reason: Not dropped, replaced by a STRONGER guard: report_helper_no_show now refuses a no-show when the Helpr has arrived OR completed (RAISE 'helper_already_arrived'), a superset of the old completed-only check. The done-stamp-can't-be-undone protection is intact.

REVERSED BY THE OWNER, 2026-09-19: 'if gps is not on, they can mark themselves as arrived but can not move on until the poster marks them arrived … even if gps does confirm they are there the poster still needs ro cfnrm wither way'. Refusing a far arrival wrote NOTHING, so helper_arrived_at stayed NULL and the poster's Confirm They Arrived control — gated on that stamp — never rendered, deadlocking the job. The guard is not lost, it MOVED: the distance is still measured server-side and still withholds helper_arrival_verified_at, and the real gate (poster_confirmed_arrival_at) is now required in every case, on the tracker's Working step and on completion alike. The refusal became a returned verdict: basis='too_far' with distance_ft.

Same 2026-09-19 reversal. A phone with Location off is exactly the case the owner named: the Helpr may record the arrival, and the poster's confirmation is what unlocks work. Returned as basis='no_location' with verified=false, so nothing is verified and nothing is unlocked without the poster's tap.
Same 2026-09-19 reversal. Out-of-range coordinates still prove nothing and still withhold helper_arrival_verified_at; they no longer refuse the claim. Returned as basis='location_invalid'.

Only the removed seller-typed 4-digit code path raised it (it read the handover row the booking creates, to compare the code). The owner removed the code (2026-10-18: porch pickup, no code); the buyer's "I got it" never required a booking before or after this migration.

Owner 2026-10-19 (landlord ID by admin review): adding a property no longer needs a verified ID, because the landlord's ID photo goes to admin review together with the ownership proof. Identity is required where it matters, at rentals_invite_tenant (and the listing gates, 20261019061019), all through public.is_identity_verified.
